description: This source file defines the AdoNetGrainStorage class, which implements Orleans grain storage using relational databases via ADO.NET. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as initialization and logging functionalities. The file also contains related enums and factory methods for creating storage instances.
